name: What are the differences between asphalt shingles and metal roofing?

mainEntity.name: What are the differences between asphalt shingles and metal roofing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Asphalt shingles are popular for their affordability, ease of installation, and wide range of colors and styles, typically lasting 20-30 years. Metal roofing, conversely, offers superior durability, often lasting 40-70 years, and is highly resistant to fire, wind, and hail. While metal roofs have a higher initial cost, they can be more energy-efficient and require less maintenance over their lifespan. Discounted Roofing Co. evaluates factors like your home's pitch and your budget during consultation to recommend the best fit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Asphalt shingles are affordable and versatile with a 20-30 year lifespan. Metal roofing is more durable, lasting 40-70 years, energy-efficient, and fire-resistant, but costs more upfront.
